items.title: 3 Out-of-Favor Stocks with Warning Signs
items.summary: Rock-bottom prices don’t always mean rock-bottom businesses. The stocks we’re examining today have all touched their 52-week lows, creating a classic investor’s dilemma: bargain opportunity or value trap?

items.title: What Has Home Depot Stopped Telling You About Where Its Goods Come From?
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) stock has lost about a quarter of its value over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained close to 17%. Where the goods on its shelves come from used to be something management explained at length. Now you mostly hear how fast they arrive.

items.title: Is Lowe's Cheap Because Nobody Noticed Its Growth?
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) grew revenue faster over the past twelve months than any of the five companies it is ranked against. It is also the cheapest of them on earnings. That combination normally means the market has missed something. Here it looks more like the market is reading the growth differently than the rank does.

items.title: How gig delivery apps became retail infrastructure

items.title: Home Depot (HD) Could Be 21% Undervalued On Its Expanding Pro Supply Narrative

items.title: Home Depot Sees Broad Strength as Pro Sales, Delivery and AI Drive Share Gains
items.summary: Home Depot (NYSE:HD) executives said the retailer’s second-quarter performance exceeded its original forecast, supported by broad-based strength in core home-improvement categories, delivery investments and continued gains with professional customers despite pressure on consumer sentiment.
